subject: Private VPC — schedule architecture review & demo (next steps)
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Erin Carter <erin.carter@healthsync.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Private VPC — schedule architecture review & demo (next steps)

Hi Erin —

Thanks again for taking the discovery call this morning. Helpful to hear about your latency targets and the cradle-to-gate data residency constraints for HealthSync. As a quick recap: you want a private VPC deployment that supports PHI workloads, predictable latency under 120ms p95 for critical routes, and the ability to bring-your-own-KMS.

Next step I'd like to propose is a combined session: short product demo (15 min) + architecture review (45 min) focusing on network, KMS, and audit/logging. That gives us time to validate topology and run through required artifacts. Can you confirm which of the following slots works for your team?

- Tuesday Jan 17 — 10:00–11:00 PT
- Thursday Jan 19 — 15:00–16:00 PT

If neither works, tell me two windows (team member names + timezone) and we’ll align. Also please share the list of internal attendees (network/security contacts + any compliance stakeholders) and any specific compliance evidence you’ll want us to bring (SOC2 report, encryption keyflow diagrams, retention policy examples).

I attached a short prep pack and a network checklist. Ben (cc'd) will lead the architecture portion and bring our runbook template. We can also open a temporary ops bridge if you want on-call access during the session.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—Logan
Logan Wright
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-priv-deploy-readiness-FAQ.pdf (PDF), network-checklist.xlsx (Excel)

From: Erin Carter <erin.carter@healthsync.com>

Cc: itops@healthsync.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 16:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Private VPC — schedule architecture review & demo (next steps)

Thanks Logan — great summary and thanks for the resources. Thursday Jan 19 15:00–16:00 PT works best for our team. I'll invite: myself (Product), Marco Reyes (Security), and Priya Singh (Networking).

Quick questions before the call:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood can support customer-managed HSM (we use AWS CloudHSM)?
- Do you typically share SOC 2 Type II and encryption-at-rest diagrams ahead of an architecture review?

We'd love to see a short demo first so we can ground the architecture conversation in behavior. If possible, please include a couple of example prompts showing latency under load.

I'll accept the slot in the calendar when you send the invite.

—Erin
Erin Carter
Head of Product, HealthSync
erin.carter@healthsync.com

- 0–15 min: short product demo — latency examples & throughput notes

See you Thursday — I'll add Marco and Priya to the invite once I get their preferred emails from you.
